entities.summary: Ulrich Alexander "Rick" Fox is a Bahamian-Canadian former basketball player, three-time NBA Champion, and actor. He played in the National Basketball Association for both the Boston Celtics and Los Angeles Lakers, and played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels. He was the owner of the eSports franchise Echo Fox until his departure from the franchise in October 2019.
